object.attr: Lets the runner wait for a usable fix before starting. As implemented, 0 satellites is searching, 1 to 3 weak, 4 to 6 good and 7 or more strong; searching also shows while the location permission is not granted. Basis: as implemented.
object.description: While the Home screen is displayed, the app shall show the GPS signal quality as searching, weak, good or strong, based on the number of satellites used for the current location fix.
